AI Overview
Krillion Unlimited is a free browser trivia game that removes the daily limit of the original Krillion game. 
How It Works
The Goal: You get seven open-ended prompts (such as "Name a type of cheese" or "Name a 20th-century war"). 
Wordleverse
 +1
Timed Answers: You have 25 seconds per prompt to type a single valid answer. 
Scoring (Rarer = Deeper): Obvious, common answers give you very few points, while obscure, rare answers score higher and sink you deeper into the ocean zones. 
No Daily Cap: Unlike standard daily trivia games that limit you to one try a day, Krillion Unlimited lets you play repeatedly or explore category-specific modes (like geography, movies, and sports). 
Alternative Modes: It includes variations like Noillirk (a reverse mode where the most common answer wins instead of the rarest). 
Wordleverse
 +1
You can play free online platforms like Browsergames.gg or LinkedInPinpointAnswer.
